item.title: Perinjanam to Launch India’s First Panchayat-Level BESS Project with ₹2 Crore Support
item.description: Perinjanam, the gram panchayat known for the highest solar power usage in the country, is preparing to implement a pioneering Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project. The initiative will store 3.16 megawatts of solar energy generated every month and supply it to the Electricity Department during high-tariff night hours. item.title: Gujarat Set To See 1.67 GW Of Standalone BESS Project As GERC Gives Nod To Tariffs
item.description: Gujarat is now all set to soon see the commissioning of 1.67 GW of standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This comes after the GERC approved the tariffs of BESS project developers against a tender floated earlier by GUVNL. item.title: Hoymiles Launches Hybrid Inverter Series With AI-Based Energy Management
item.description: Hoymiles has launched its HIS-(3-6)L-G3 Series, a single-phase hybrid inverter platform for residential applications. According to the company, the inverter series is available in 3 kW to 6 kW power classes and is designed for use in integrated home energy systems. It supports parallel operation of up to 10 units, allowing system capacity to be expanded based on demand. item.title: Google and Xcel Energy to Deploy 300MW / 30GWh Form Iron-Air Battery in Minnesota
item.description: Google and Xcel Energy have reached a definitive agreement to deploy a 300MW / 30GWh iron-air battery system in Pine Island, Minnesota, a project set to become the largest battery installation ever announced globally by energy capacity. The system will use technology developed by Form Energy and will support a new Google data centre. item.title: India’s Energy Demand Up 40% in Decade as AI, Gas and Renewables Reshape Mix: Shell
item.description: Despite global disruptions over the past few years, India has made considerable progress in transforming its energy system. India’s energy demand grew by nearly 40% over the past decade, driven by rapid economic and population growth. In a report shared by Shell India, this surge in demand is expected to help India surpass energy demand in the United States in the 2040s and China in the 2060s. item.title: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta Lays Foundation Stone for 55.5 MW/111 MWh BESS Projects
item.description: Delhi is set to host four standalone utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across South and West Delhi, adding 55.5 MW / 111 MWh of storage capacity. The projects also include the development of underground cabling in Chandni Chowk and the laying of the foundation stone for a 66/11 kV, 63 MVA GIS indoor grid substation at Mandoli. item.title: Tripura Floats EOI for 50 MW/200 MWh BESS With 4-Hour Peak Discharge
item.description: To support Tripura's renewable energy integration, enhance grid reliability, and manage peak demand, Tripura State Electricity Corporation Limited has sought an Expression of Interest (EoI) for developing a battery energy storage project in the state. Tripura issued a tender seeking EoI for developing a 50 MW / 200 MWh Standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) tender. The project will be set up at the 33 kV level in 5 MW / 20 MWh modules. item.title: Green Stocks Feb 27: Renewable Energy Pack Weakens, Few Stocks Defy Downtrend
item.description: As the stock market closed for the week, green energy stocks ended on a somber note, with most companies in the segment finishing in the red, even as both the NIFTY and Sensex declined today. Only a handful of stocks bucked the broader trend. Alpex Solar emerged as one of the top gainers, rising over 5%, followed by Vikram Solar, which staged a partial recovery from losses recorded over the past week. item.title: Rajasthan Approves Hybrid Inverters for Rooftop Solar Amid Growing BESS Focus
item.description: Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (JVVNL) has now allowed the use of hybrid inverters for Rooftop Solar (RTS) systems in Rajasthan. JVVNL brought the latest notice in view of the increasing Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) use, which has assumed importance in the power distribution network. The state's need for the BESS project is being driven by increasing renewable energy sources integration and the growing need to manage grid stability, peak load management, and improve power quality.
